name: TOTP Sign-In Flow Handler
summary: Resolves the durable identity from a password-issued MFA challenge, verifies the submitted TOTP proof through the real MFA manager, and consumes the challenge before session-specific completion occurs.

sourceReferences.note: The typed handler rejects missing, mismatched, expired, or provider-ineligible MFA challenges before credential proof; valid TOTP is verified as step-up through AppUserMfaManager and the MFA challenge is consumed only after proof succeeds.
